mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM app_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT note_id, request_sha256 FROM ma_note_request WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND idempotency_key = #{key}

SELECT r.note_id, s.source_id, v.version, n.title, v.body_markdown, v.status AS index_status, v.created_at AS updated_at, s.status AS source_status FROM ma_note_request r JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = r.source_id AND s.account_id = r.account_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = s.current_version JOIN ma_note_version n ON n.source_id = v.source_id AND n.version = v.version WHERE r.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.note_id = #{noteId} AND s.type = 'NOTE'

SELECT s.source_id,s.type,s.origin_id,s.status,s.created_at,s.current_version, v.status AS index_status,v.answer_state FROM ma_source s JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = s.current_version WHERE s.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.source_id = #{sourceId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
